intent: The scrollable listbox of a Command that holds its items, groups, separators and empty message.

dont_use_when.situation: A scrolling region of a page or panel that is not the list of a Command

invariants.text: The list renders with `role="listbox"` and takes its `aria-label` from its own `label` prop, not the root's (the library's default is "Suggestions"), set after the caller's props.
command.module.css caps the list at 18.75rem and scrolls it vertically; the library sets the `--cmdk-list-height` custom property on the list to the height of its content.

anti_patterns.do_instead: Pass `label`; the component sets `aria-label` from it after the caller's props

children.states: children is the list's items, groups, separators and empty message
children.because: `React.ReactNode` is a union of elements, strings, numbers, fragments and more; the compiler emits one JSON type per property.

unexposed_parts.reason: A div inside the list that holds the children and is measured for `--cmdk-list-height`; fixed markup, not a component of its own.

good.title: A list with an empty message and a group

bad.title: The search field placed inside the list
bad.why: CommandInput is a sibling of CommandList under Command; inside the listbox it scrolls away with the items and sits inside the element it controls.
